summary: The Access page handles large installs: quick filters per column, Azure items grouped by scope, pins, and giving or removing access for many boxes at once.

new.title: Quick filters and Azure grouping
new.text: Each column has filters for type, tier and staged changes. Azure items are grouped by management group, subscription and resource group, closed by default on long lists.

new.title: Pins and many at once
new.text: Pin the boxes you work on so they stay visible. Select several boxes in one column and drop them on a target, or remove them together. A tray lists staged changes with undo.
